# NC State News

> NC State News is the central hub for university research discoveries, expert commentary, and institutional announcements from North Carolina State University.

This news portal aggregates research updates, faculty expertise, and university communications while providing resources for media professionals, journalists, and internal stakeholders. It serves as both a public-facing news source and a behind-the-scenes support hub for media relations and communications.

## Key Topics

- NC State University
- University Research
- Media Relations
- Campus Experts
- Faculty Recognition
- Expert Directory
- News Services
- University Communications
- Sustainability
- Public Relations
- Communications Training
- Day of Giving
- Research Innovation
- Media Contact
- Technical Support

## Core News & Research

- [NC State News Homepage](https://news.ncsu.edu): Homepage for NC State University news and research updates
- [Results: the Research and Innovation Magazine of NC State](https://news.ncsu.edu/results): Official research and innovation magazine showcasing NC State discoveries
- [About NC State News](https://news.ncsu.edu/about): About page describing NC State News portal and communication products
- [In the News Features](https://news.ncsu.edu/in-the-news): Aggregation of NC State expert coverage and press releases in media

## Media & Broadcast Resources

- [For Media](https://news.ncsu.edu/for-media): Media resources and broadcast facilities for journalists and broadcasters
- [TV Studio](https://news.ncsu.edu/for-media/tv-studio): TV broadcast studio facility information and technical support details
- [Contact NC State News](https://news.ncsu.edu/about/contact): Contact information for NC State News and University Communications
- [Send a Tip](https://news.ncsu.edu/about/send-a-tip): Submit story tips and news ideas to NC State News Services

## Expert Directories & Commentary

- [NC State Experts Available on Climate Change](https://news.ncsu.edu/nc-state-experts-available-on-climate-youth-activism): Directory of NC State climate and environmental experts for media contact
- [NC State Hurricane Experts](https://news.ncsu.edu/for-media/hurricane-experts): Expert directory of NC State faculty available for hurricane coverage
- [NC State Supply Chain Experts](https://news.ncsu.edu/for-media/nc-state-supply-chain-experts): Directory of NC State supply chain and operations management experts

## Faculty & Staff Support

- [Faculty Support](https://news.ncsu.edu/faculty-support): Resources and support services for NC State faculty media relations
- [Communications Training](https://news.ncsu.edu/communications-training): Communications training and professional development for NC State staff

## Multimedia & Podcasts

- [Audio Abstract Podcast](https://news.ncsu.edu/podcast): Audio Abstract podcast featuring NC State research and faculty interviews

## Featured Stories

- [Reevaluating Reaction Rates to Better Understand the Stars](https://news.ncsu.edu/2026/03/reevaluating-reaction-rates-to-better-understand-the-stars): Research news on thermonuclear reaction rates and stellar physics
- [The 'Itch-to-Brain' Circuit, Neural Change and Depression](https://news.ncsu.edu/2026/03/the-itch-to-brain-circuit-neural-change-and-depression): Research news on chronic itch and depression neural connections
- [Clark Inducted Into Order of the Long Leaf Pine](https://news.ncsu.edu/2026/03/clark-inducted-into-order-of-the-long-leaf-pine): Faculty recognition of Jim Clark's state honor for community service
- [Orchestras Celebrate 10 Years of World Premieres](https://news.ncsu.edu/2026/03/orchestras-celebrate-10-years-of-world-premieres): Feature on NC State orchestras' 10-year world premiere composition tradition
